name: to-csp-v2
source: built by tools/gen/space-more-vectors.py from values chosen there; layout restated from libcsp csp_id.c (CSP 1.x: priority at bit 30, source 25, destination 20, ports 14 and 8, flags 0) and libcsp csp_id.c (CSP 2.x: priority at bit 46, destination 32, source 18, ports 12 and 6, flags 0, sent as the high 48 bits of a big-endian 64-bit word); HMAC and RDP flags; every value fits the 2.x header; expect derived there, no engine run
